allow.reason: Fixed in @faker-js/faker 10.5+, which is ESM-only; this family compiles to CommonJS on Node >=18, so the upgrade needs an ESM migration. Nothing in the family's own code calls faker.helpers.fake(), but randomUtils re-exports the whole faker API, so a consuming project must not pass untrusted input to it.
